Title: Visualización del panorama de producción científica sobre el aprendizaje del entrenador deportivo con herramienta-Bibliometrix: revisión bibliométrica y exploratoria de dos décadas de investigación
Abstract: Various studies have examined sports coaches to understand their impact on performance, knowledge acquisition, and athlete training. However, to date, there is no bibliometric study analyzing research trends in coach learning. The objectives of the study were to map the scientific production landscape on sports coach learning to identify thematic gaps and develop an exploratory review to analyze categories of analysis related to knowledge acquisition processes. The search date was set between 1998 and 2024. The Scopus, Web of Science, PubMed, and Google Scholar databases were consulted. The analysis was performed using Bibliometrix software. A total of 197 documents were included. The years 2021 and 2024 report the highest number of published studies. Scientific production on sports coach learning has been researched mainly from a qualitative approach (82.22%) and to a lesser extent from a quantitative approach (11.11%). The most productive countries are the United Kingdom and Canada. The International Journal of Sport Science and Coaching and Sheffield Hallam University have published the largest number of studies. The most relevant concepts were “learning,” “education,” and “mentoring.” Most research focuses on how coaches learn through formal and informal means. The increase in academic productivity demonstrates a positive willingness on the part of the international scientific community to understand the role of sports coaches from a teaching-learning perspective.

Title: TR Dizin Verilerinin Bibliyometrik Analizi: Web of Science ve Scopus Örnekleri Üzerinden Katkılar ve Öneriler
Abstract: Bu çalışmanın temel amacı, ulusal akademik veri tabanı olan TR Dizin verilerinin VOSviewer ve Bibliometrix gibi küresel bibliyometrikanaliz araçlarıyla yapısal uyumluluğunu incelemek ve verilerin doğrudan analiz edilebilirliğine yönelik metodolojik bir çerçeve sunmaktır.Nitel araştırma deseninde kurgulanan bu çalışmada, veriler doküman analizi tekniğiyle incelenmiş ve örneklem seçiminde amaçlıörneklem yöntemi kullanılmıştır. TR Dizin veri setinin bibliyometrik analiz süreçlerinde oluşturduğu teknik kısıtlılıkları tespit etmek vebunlara uygulanabilir çözümler üretebilmek amacıyla, Scopus veri tabanının dışa aktarım formatı karşılaştırmalı referans olarak alınmıştır.Verilerin düzenlenmesi ve temizlenmesi aşamalarında Microsoft Excel ile Google E-Tablolar; analiz süreçlerinde ise RStudio ortamındaçalışan Bibliometrix paketi kullanılmıştır. Araştırma kapsamında, TR Dizin verilerinin bibliyometrik analizinde karşılaşılan başlıcateknik ve yapısal problemler detaylı biçimde ele alınmıştır. Araştırma bulguları; TR Dizin veri setinde dil, yazım, noktalama işaretlerininstandartlaştırılması ve üst veri erişiminin iyileştirilmesi yönünde yapılacak yapısal düzenlemelerin mevcut sorunları ortadan kaldıracağınıgöstermektedir. Önerilen bu yapısal iyileştirmelerin hayata geçirilmesinin, TR Dizin verilerinin VOSviewer ve Bibliometrix gibi araçlarladoğrudan ve etkin bir biçimde analiz edilebilmesine zemin hazırlayacağı sonucuna varılmıştır.

Title: DIGITAL DA’WAH AND SOCIAL MEDIA ALGORITHMS: A Bibliometric Analysis of Global Reasearch
Abstract: ABSTRACT The development of digital technology and social media has driven a significant transformation in da'wah practices from a conventional space to a dynamic digital ecosystem. However, there are still research gaps in mapping scientific structures, publication trends, and conceptual dynamics, especially related to the role of social media algorithms. The purpose of this study is to map the development of digital da'wah through a bibliometrix approach. Data was collected from Scopus and analyzed with Bibliometrix (Biblioshiny) in the period 2015-2025. The results show a significant growth in publications of 34.4% per year, with social media as the central theme related to issues of Islam, identity, and Islamophobia. Thematic mapping places religion and Muslims as the motor themes, social media and COVID-19 as basic themes that continue to develop, with a moderate level of citation that shows that this field is still in the emerging stage. This digital da'wah is changing the pattern of religious communication, including a shift in authority and the emergence of challenges such as misinformation and the influence of algorithms. Thus, digital da'wah needs to be implemented through an adaptive approach based on digital literacy, it is necessary to ethical values so that the message is accurate, wise, and responsible. Keywords : digital dakwah; social media; algoritms; misinformation; bibliometrix analysis

Title: Replication material for "Multiplex coupling: Connecting the intellectual base and the topics of a research field"
Abstract: Replication material for: Aria, M., Cuccurullo, C. & Spano, M. Multiplex coupling: Connecting the intellectual base and the topics of a research field (submitted to Quantitative Science Studies). Multiplex coupling couples the same documents by their cited references and by their terms, keeps the two layers separate and analyses their relation: roots (clusters of the references layer), themes (clusters of the topic layer), the links between them, and the pairs of roots over time. The method is implemented in the R package bibliometrix. Contents: disinformation_openalex.rds: the disinformation collection (OpenAlex, 2,272 journal articles), as a bibliometrix data frame; scalability_openalex.rds: the larger OpenAlex collection used for the computing times; xai_scopus_identifiers.csv: Scopus EIDs, DOIs and years of the explainable AI collection (Scopus records cannot be redistributed; the query is in the README); cleaning_lists.zip: keyword cleaning lists (synonyms, variants, terms removed) of the three collections; scripts.zip: the R scripts that produce every number, table and figure of the paper and of its Supplementary Material. The management collection (Web of Science) is distributed with bibliometrix through loadBookDataset(). Version 2: results recomputed with bibliometrix at commit 9f0a413 of the feature/multiplex branch (version 1: 69f3ce0). The changes affect only the names of some roots and the legend of the greyscale links plot; every number of the paper is unchanged except the computing times. The script of the table of root profiles now lists the roots whose structure persists.

Title: Bibliometric analysis of research trends on the epiretinal membrane since 2000
Abstract: Epiretinal membrane (ERM) is an important retinal disorder, yet its global research landscape has not been systematically evaluated. This study conducted a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of ERM-related publications indexed in the Web of Science Core Collection. Data were analyzed using CiteSpace, bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and the bibliometrix R package to assess publication trends, international collaboration, influential journals, and evolving research topics. A total of 1,059 articles published between 2000 and 2024 were included. The annual number of publications showed a steady increase, with the United States and other developed countries contributing the majority of research output. Journal analysis identified Retina-The Journal of Retinal and Vitreous Diseases as the leading outlet in terms of productivity. Keyword co-occurrence and co-citation analyses revealed that current research hotspots involve epidemiology, molecular mechanisms, imaging biomarkers associated with surgical outcomes, and the emerging use of artificial intelligence in diagnosis and prognosis prediction. These findings provide an integrated overview of ERM research development, highlight major thematic shifts, and offer valuable guidance for future investigations in this field.

Title: BIBLIOMETRIC ANALYSIS OF SCIENTIFIC PUBLICATIONS ON THE KEYWORD “CORPUS LINGUISTICS”: BASED ON SCOPUS DATA (2015–2025)
Abstract: This study aims to identify development trends, structural characteristics, and major research directions in scientific publications in the field of corpus linguistics. The purpose of the research is to determine the scientific productivity of the field, publication dynamics, leading authors and countries, patterns of international scientific collaboration, as well as dominant thematic trends by conducting a bibliometric analysis of publications on corpus linguistics published between 2015 and 2025 based on the Scopus database. Bibliometric analysis was used as the main research method. Data were retrieved from the Scopus database using the keyword “corpus linguistics,” resulting in 23,073 documents; after applying a time filter (2015–2025), 16,475 documents were downloaded, and following data cleaning with the Bibliometrix software, 16,402 scientific documents were included in the analysis. Bibliographic data were processed in the RStudio programming environment using the Bibliometrix package and the Biblioshiny interface. The analysis examined the annual dynamics of publications, author and country-level collaboration, the most frequently used keywords, and thematic networks. The results indicate rapid growth in corpus linguistics publications, expanding international collaboration, and a shift toward computational approaches. The study systematizes current trends and provides a foundation for future research.

Title: Innovation financière entre croissance économique et crises financières : une analyse bibliométrique complète et cartographie scientifique
Abstract: Cette étude vise à réaliser une analyse Bibliometrix et une cartographie scientifique de la littérature consacrée à l'innovation financière à l'intersection de la croissance économique et des crises financières. À partir d'un corpus extrait de la base Scopus et analysé via les outils Bibliometrix, la recherche met en évidence une forte accélération des publications depuis 2020, traduisant l'intérêt croissant pour la fintech, la finance digitale et la durabilité. Les résultats révèlent une structuration du champ autour de trois pôles majeurs : innovation financière et croissance, finance digitale, et finance verte. L'analyse montre également la prédominance de la Chine et une internationalisation accrue des collaborations scientifiques. L'évolution thématique indique un déplacement progressif d'une approche centrée sur le développement financier vers une perspective intégrant les enjeux environnementaux et de stabilité systémique. L'étude souligne ainsi la transformation du paradigme académique vers une vision multidimensionnelle de l'innovation financière.

Title: De la production scientifique aux thématiques émergentes: Une Analyse Bibliométrique Croisée de la Transformation Digitale et du Capital Humain
Abstract: Résumé : Cet article propose une analyse bibliométrique approfondie de la littérature portant sur laco-thématique transformation digitale et capital humain, afin d’examiner l’évolutiontemporelle de la production scientifique, d’identifier les acteurs les plus influents et de cartographier la structure intellectuelle du champ. L’étude repose sur un corpus de 455 articles scientifiques indexés dans la base de données Scopus et adopte une approche bibliométrique combinant des analyses de performance et de science mapping, réalisées à l’aide des logiciels spécialisés VOSviewer et Bibliometrix. Les résultats de cette étude sont importants et tirent plusieurs conclusions importantes : la croissance significative et soutenue des publications au cours de la dernière décennie, confirmant l’intérêt croissant et le caractère toujours actuel de cette thématique dans les débats académiques et managériaux, la concentration de la recherche dans des revues spécifiques indexées spécialisées en économie et management, l’analyse révèle également les auteurs, revues et pays les plus influents, avec une dominance marquée de la Chine, qui se positionne comme le pays le plus productif et disposant d’un vaste réseau de collaborations internationales. Ainsi que les tendances récentes montrent une réelle progression des thématiques passant des thèmes conjoncturels vers des thèmes structurels et stratégiques. Title: Mapping Strategic Themes and Clusters in Lean-Green Operations Management Strategies and Sustainability Performance: A Bibliometric Analysis
Abstract: This study aims to map the strategic themes and research clusters related to lean-green operations management strategies and sustainability performance. A bibliometric analysis was conducted using a structured workflow supported by Biblioshiny, the web-based interface of the Bibliometrix R package. The dataset comprised 798 peer-reviewed articles published between 2019 and 2025, retrieved from scientific databases, including Web of Science, Scopus, and MDPI. Performance analysis and science mapping were conducted using Bibliometrix and Biblioshiny. The findings identified five well-established motor themes: sustainable performance, lean manufacturing, green supply chain management, green innovation, and the circular economy, which represent the core areas of the research field. Three niche themes, including green human resource management and environmental frameworks, reflect specialized research areas, while emerging themes such as lean production and lean thinking indicate evolving research frontiers. Four basic themes, including dynamic capabilities and sustainability performance measurement, highlight critical gaps in theoretical and empirical development. The study proposes a conceptual framework linking lean-green operations management strategies with sustainability performance, providing firms with a pathway to achieve operational excellence while advancing environmental and social sustainability. This study contributes to the literature by integrating lean and green operations management perspectives and offering a knowledge roadmap that connects foundational concepts with emerging themes and future research directions.

Title: Bibliometric analysis of ovarian cancer immune evasion research from 2015 to 2024
Abstract: Background: Ovarian cancer remains lethal and shows limited response to immunotherapy partly due to immune evasion. We mapped global research trends on ovarian cancer immune evasion during 2015-2024. Methods: Web of Science Core Collection and Scopus were searched on 6 Oct 2025 for English articles and reviews published 1 Jan 2015-31 Dec 2024. Records were merged and deduplicated in R (bibliometrix). Productivity, collaboration, keywords, thematic clusters, and burst terms and citations were analyzed using bibliometrix, VOSviewer, and CiteSpace. Results: A total of 496 publications from 202 sources were included, showing rapid growth (annual growth rate ~24.6%) with a marked rise after 2020. The United States and China contributed the most output, whereas international collaboration was limited (~9.7% of authors with multiple-country affiliations). Keyword co-occurrence revealed major themes in immunotherapy, tumor microenvironment remodeling, immune checkpoint regulation, resistance mechanisms, and genetic/epigenetic modulation. Emerging hotspots highlighted tumor-associated macrophages and STAT3-centered signaling as key drivers of immune suppression and therapeutic resistance. Conclusion: Research on ovarian cancer immune evasion is expanding quickly and is shifting toward actionable targets and combination strategies. Strengthening cross-country collaboration and focusing on TME- and STAT3/TAM-directed interventions may accelerate translation and improve immunotherapy outcomes.

Title: Scientific development of Olympic combat sports research: a bibliometric analysis from 1943 to 2025
Abstract: Abstract Purpose To map the scientific landscape of Olympic combat sports by identifying publication trends, citation impact, collaboration networks, and leading contributors among boxing, fencing, judo, taekwondo, and wrestling. Methods A bibliometric analysis was conducted using the Web of Science Core Collection. Publications related to boxing, fencing, judo, taekwondo, and wrestling were retrieved and analyzed through performance indicators, collaboration networks, historiographic mapping, topic modeling, and temporal trend analyses. The data was imported into Bibliometrix software, and the bibliometric analyses were performed using the Bibliometrix package in R and Python were employed to enhance figure visualization. Results A total of 9604 studies remained for the bibliometric analysis from 1943 to 2025, including judo ( n = 2785), wrestling ( n = 2268), boxing ( n = 1912), taekwondo ( n = 1828), and fencing ( n = 811). Scientific production increased substantially after the early 2000s. The United States, Brazil, South Korea, and Poland emerged as leading contributors depending on the modality. Judo showed the largest publication growth and the most extensive collaboration network. Topic modeling identified 34 research themes, with growing emphasis on neuromuscular performance, biomechanics, evidence synthesis, and psychological factors. Conclusion Olympic combat sports research has evolved into an increasingly internationalized and multidisciplinary field, characterized by growing collaboration networks and expanding scientific interests beyond traditional physiological approaches.

Title: Analiza bibliometryczna badań nad ubezpieczeniami osobowymi
Abstract: CEL: Celem pracy jest ukazanie kierunków i dynamiki rozwoju badań nad ubezpieczeniami osobowymi w lite- raturze indeksowanej w bazie Web of Science, ze szczególnym uwzględnieniem dynamiki publikacji w czasie, struktury tematycznej oraz wiodących ośrodków naukowych i instytucji kształtujących ten dyskurs. METODA: Zastosowano analizę bibliometryczną obejmującą 4191 dokumentów opublikowanych w latach 1907–2025, z wykorzystaniem pakietu bibliometrix w środowisku R oraz narzędzia biblioshiny. WYNIKI I WNIOSKI: Wyniki wskazują na wyraźne przyspieszenie dynamiki publikacji w ostatnich dekadach oraz duże rozproszenie klastrów tematycznych, co świadczy o interdyscyplinarnym i wciąż niedojrzałym cha- rakterze pola badawczego. Zidentyfikowano wiodące ośrodki naukowe i instytucje kształtujące dyskurs, przy jednoczesnym braku silnie zintegrowanego rdzenia tematycznego. Stanowi punkt odniesienia i mapę literatury użyteczną dla badaczy, praktyków rynku ubezpie- czeniowego oraz decydentów polityki społecznej. Title: Bibliometric Dataset for Artificial Intelligence and Student Retention Research (Scopus, 2015–2025)
Abstract: This dataset supports a bibliometric review of research on artificial intelligence for student retention published between 2015 and 2025. The deposited R workspace (Bibliometrics_Scopus_AI_Retention_2889.RData) contains the bibliographic data and analytical objects used in the study. The dataset comprises 2,889 records retrieved from Scopus using a structured search strategy covering the educational context, student retention and dropout outcomes, and artificial intelligence and predictive methods. It was prepared for bibliometric performance analysis, science mapping, and the identification of influential studies for subsequent full-text content analysis. Bibliometric analyses were conducted in R using the bibliometrix package. The deposited resource is intended to support transparency, methodological traceability, and reproducibility of the study. Title: The Evolution of Academic Literature on Overtourism Analysis
Abstract: This study examines the evolution of overtourism research through a bibliometric analysis of 425 articles published in Scopus between 2017 and 2025. The findings show that publication volume increased rapidly after 2018 and peaked in 2020. Overtourism is particularly associated with themes such as sustainability, destination management, and social carrying capacity. Western Europe and the United States were identified as leading contributors, while Africa and Central Asia remained underrepresented. Conducted using the R-based Bibliometrix package, the study highlights the need for sustainable and community-focused policy responses.

abstract: This study examines the evolution of overtourism research through a bibliometric analysis of 425 articles published in Scopus between 2017 and 2025. The findings show that publication volume increased rapidly after 2018 and peaked in 2020. Overtourism is particularly associated with themes such as sustainability, destination management, and social carrying capacity. Western Europe and the United States were identified as leading contributors, while Africa and Central Asia remained underrepresented. Conducted using the R-based Bibliometrix package, the study highlights the need for sustainable and community-focused policy responses.
